digest.component_or_area: editor test fixture instrumentation / CI observability
propositions: A recurring 35-second setup delay in test_server_binds_loopback_only is caused by CPython ThreadingHTTPServer constructor synchronously calling socket.getfqdn on numeric loopback 127.0.0.1, triggering a macOS resolver timeout.
Existing pytest duration reports show only aggregate fixture setup phases; nested timing instrumentation is required to isolate and confirm the getfqdn bottleneck before implementing a fix.

Instrumentation must measure fixture setup, server constructor, TCP bind, and getfqdn spans separately using a thresholded pytest observer that emits only spans >1 second and remains silent outside CI or explicit opt-in.

Deterministic tests and an organic post-merge macOS CI run must prove the timing observer correctly attributes the delay to socket.getfqdn and rules out TCP bind, _no_repo_commits, and generic worker starvation.
